Text: Your astronomers have identified planets suitable for terraforming

“Each has Earth-like gravity,” {d(Techy)} drones, “revolves semi-frequently, possesses a magnetosphere, has surface water...”

“Yes, yes!” you bluster. “What's our next step?”

“To bring one into our domain: then we can begin the terraforming process. Our engineers are repairing the Eden ship as we speak.”
